summary: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. (BBVA) filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share repurchase transactions under the third tranche of its buyback program. Between May 18-22, 2026, BBVA purchased 6,475,290 shares across trading venues (mainly XMAD) at weighted average prices ranging from €18.7990 to €19.3928 per share. The total cash deployed to date for this tranche is €342,180,329.95, representing 23.44% of the maximum cash amount. Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG serves as manager. This is an ordinary open-market buyback execution update, not a special-situation event.
